title: Chapter 320 Undead Bone Dragon
content:
Chapter 320 Undead Bone Dragon

[The Shanhai City defense war officially begins. ]

[Killing the undead will earn you military merit points. Please explore the specific rules yourself. ]

The system prompt sounded, and Wang Shuo had received the news in advance.

It was almost the same as Sauron said.

In the sound of war drums.

The first wave of undead beasts had already arrived at the city, but they had no way to climb up the 30-meter-high wall.

They could only use their huge bodies and sharp fangs to destroy the durability of the wall.

In the air, there were also various undead birds attacking the light curtain.

One of the undead bone dragons had a wingspan of 15 meters and was made of skeletons, but it could still fly in the air.

It opened its mouth and sprayed a blazing flame, burning the white light curtain.

Before it could spray the second mouthful, a huge spear flew out and knocked it down into the air.

The soldiers on the wall also began to fight back.

The archers shot countless arrows from a high position, and the dense rain of arrows caused a large number of casualties to the undead beasts.

Arrow towers are more efficient than archers, just like "pear blossoms in the rain".

Wang Shuo placed 40 catapults on the horse face.

The attack power of catapults is much higher than that of bronze crossbow carts. Facing dense undead beasts, the lethality is naturally greater.

"Bang..."

The projectiles exploded among the undead beasts, and some fragile undead beasts, such as undead hounds and undead antelopes, were directly killed.

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that in addition to his own catapults, only Shanhai City had one.

Shanhai City's catapults were more powerful than his own catapults.

Wang Shuo checked a catapult near the city wall and found that it was a heavy catapult.

This type of catapult is immovable, and the projectiles it fired are 5 times larger than those fired by light catapults.

Wang Shuo swallowed his saliva. If he was hit by such a projectile, he would probably die.

Life is so fragile!

It is estimated that only those generals with a health value of over 10,000 can resist it!

Wang Shuo's heart was more eager to become a general.

At the East Gate, many lords were envious of Wang Shuo for having so many catapults.

You know, in this defensive battle, every time you kill an undead, you will get different military merit points according to the level and level of the general.

These are all real benefits.

Wang Shuo's catapult can be said to be a killer weapon for brushing military merit points. Other lords can only stare blankly.

In addition to the catapult, Wang Shuo also brought a large number of bows and arrows. Although other professions do not have any skills and attack bonuses when using bows and arrows, they can still exert their own attack power.

As a result, Wana Town's military merit points immediately occupied the second place. Just 10 minutes after the start of the war, it already had 30,000 military merit points.

As for the first place, forget it, Shanhai City itself is also on the list.

For the sake of fairness, Wang Shuo evenly distributed the section of the wall he defended to the various mayors and lords of the Changping County coalition army, so that everyone would have a share, so as not to cause dissatisfaction among the people.

If there are military merit points, everyone will brush them together, and if there are dangers, they will naturally shoulder them together.

For those lords who did not carry enough bows and arrows, Wang Shuo generously provided them with bows and arrows.

This move won the favor of everyone.

The first wave of the attack of the undead beasts lasted about 4 hours.

Their main purpose was to consume the long-range weapons of Shanhai City and at the same time wear down the durability of the city wall.

General Arif Upol, standing on the high platform, watched the undead beasts being almost consumed.

Then a new combat order was issued.
